module.updates.name: TSQ Bot Updates (game updates)
module.updates.description: Posts one card to the updates channel when a followed game publishes an official update / patch notes post. Games: Counter-Strike 2 (Steam), World of Warcraft: Forever (Blizzard forum).
about.attr.steam: Game update announcements: title, link and publication time (official Steam Web API, ISteamNews).

about.attr.blizzard_forum_terms: Blizzard forum rules and terms of use
